33828-abbreviations-and-signs-a-primer-o.title: In Most Common Use
33828-abbreviations-and-signs-a-primer-o.creator: Unknown
33828-abbreviations-and-signs-a-primer-o.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Certain special forms of printing such as market and stock reports, sporting news, price lists, directories, telephone directories, and the like make extensive use of abbreviations and signs. These abbreviations are of very limited use and often of only temporary life. They are not intelligible to general readers and should never be used outside the particular form of composition to which they pertain.

60651-dr-wainwright-s-patient-a-novel.title: Dr Wainwright S Patient A Novel
60651-dr-wainwright-s-patient-a-novel.creator: Edmund Yates
60651-dr-wainwright-s-patient-a-novel.description: A book by Edmund Yates. "Change for Sandington Cove and Waverley," is a very different place from what it was even ten years ago. To be sure the sea is there, and the beach, and the fishing-luggers with the red sails; but in everything else what changes!

arxiv-2201-11305.title: The Quadratic Wasserstein Metric With Squaring Scaling For Seismic Velocity Inversion
arxiv-2201-11305.creator: Zhengyang Li, Yijia Tang, Jing Chen, Hao Wu
arxiv-2201-11305.description: Abstract The quadratic Wasserstein metric has shown its power in measuring the difference between probability densities, which benefits optimization objective function with better convexity and is insensitive to data noise. Nevertheless, it is always an important question to make the seismic signals suitable for comparison using the quadratic Wasserstein metric.

arxiv-2203-10472.title: FEDERATED SPATIAL REUSE OPTIMIZATION IN NEXT-GENERATION DECENTRALIZED IEEE 802.11 WLANS
arxiv-2203-10472.creator: Francesc Wilhelmi, Jernej Hribar, Selim F. Yilmaz, Emre Ozfatura, Kerem Ozfatura, Ozlem Yildiz, Deniz Gündüz, Hao Chen, Xiaoying Ye, Lizhao You, Yulin Shao, Paolo Dini, Boris Bellalta
arxiv-2203-10472.description: Abstract As wireless standards evolve, more complex functionalities are introduced to address the increasing requirements in terms of throughput, latency, security, and efficiency. To unleash the potential of such new features, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are currently being exploited for deriving models and protocols from data, rather than by hand-programming.

arxiv-2206-11566.title: INTERPLAY: An Intelligent Model for Predicting Performance Degradation due to Multi-cache Way-disabling
arxiv-2206-11566.creator: Panagiota Nikolaou 1 2 , Yiannakis Sazeides 2 , Maria K. Michael 1 2
arxiv-2206-11566.description: Abstract Modern and future processors need to remain functionally correct in the presence of permanent faults to sustain scaling benefits and limit field returns. This paper presents a combined analytical and microarchitectural simulation-based framework called INTERPLAY, that can rapidly predict, at design-time, the performance degradation expected from a processor employing way-disabling to handle permanent faults in caches while in-the-field.

arxiv-2311-07946.title: The Impact of Adversarial Node Placement in Decentralized Federated Learning Networks Thanks: This project was supported in part by ONR under grants N000142112472 and N000142212305, and by NSF under grants CNS-2146171 and ITE-2326898
arxiv-2311-07946.creator: Adam Piaseczny 1 , Eric Ruzomberka 2 , Rohit Parasnis 3 , Christopher G. Brinton 1
arxiv-2311-07946.description: Abstract As Federated Learning (FL) grows in popularity, new decentralized frameworks are becoming widespread. These frameworks leverage the benefits of decentralized environments to enable fast and energy-efficient inter-device communication. However, this growing popularity also intensifies the need for robust security measures.

arxiv-2403-07575.title: Emergent (2+1)D topological orders from iterative (1+1)D gauging
arxiv-2403-07575.creator: José Garre-Rubio
arxiv-2403-07575.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by José Garre-Rubio. Gauging introduces gauge fields in order to localize an existing global symmetry, resulting in a dual global symmetry on the gauge fields that can be gauged again. By iterating the gauging process on spin chains with Abelian group symmetries and arranging the gauge fields in a 2D lattice, the local symmetries become the stabilizer of the X ​ Z ​ Z ​ X XZZX -code for any Abelian group.

arxiv-2408-03518.title: Large positive magnetoconductance in carbon nanoscrolls
arxiv-2408-03518.creator: Yu-Jie Zhong, Jia-Cheng Li, Xuan-Fu Huang, Ying-Je Lee, Ting-Zhen Chen, Jia-Ren Zhang, Angus Huang, Hsiu-Chuan Hsu, Carmine Ortix, Ching-Hao Chang
arxiv-2408-03518.description: Abstract We theoretically demonstrate that carbon nanoscrolls – spirally wrapped graphene layers with open endpoints – can be characterized by a large positive magnetoconductance. We show that when a carbon nanoscroll is subject to an axial magnetic field of several Tesla, the ballistic conductance at low carrier densities of the nanoscroll has an increase of about 200%.

arxiv-2501-08551.title: A Theory of Optimistically Universal Online Learnability for General Concept Classes
arxiv-2501-08551.creator: Steve Hanneke, Hongao Wang
arxiv-2501-08551.description: Abstract We provide a full characterization of the concept classes that are optimistically universally online learnable with { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} labels. The notion of optimistically universal online learning was defined in ( Hanneke, 2021 ) in order to understand learnability under minimal assumptions.

arxiv-2505-11236.title: ForgetMeNot: Understanding and Modeling the Impact of Forever Chemicals Toward Sustainable Large-Scale Computing Conference: ; ; CCS: Computer systems organization Cloud computing CCS: Social and professional topics Sustainability
arxiv-2505-11236.creator: Rohan Basu Roy, Raghavendra Kanakagiri, Yankai Jiang, Devesh Tiwari
arxiv-2505-11236.description: Abstract . Abstract. Fluorinated compounds, often referred to as forever chemicals, are critical in various steps of semiconductor fabrication like lithography, etching, chamber cleaning, and others. Forever chemical emissions can exhibit global warming potentials thousands of times greater than carbon dioxide and persist in the atmosphere for millennia.

arxiv-2505-14367.title: Dual Decomposition of Weights and Singular Value Low Rank Adaptation
arxiv-2505-14367.creator: Jialong Han, Si Zhang, Ke Zhang
arxiv-2505-14367.description: Abstract Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a critical paradigm for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, among which Low-rank Adaptation (LoRA) represents one of the most widely adopted methodologies. However, existing LoRA-based approaches exhibit two fundamental limitations: unstable training dynamics and inefficient knowledge transfer from pre-trained models, both stemming from random initialization of adapter parameters.

arxiv-2507-18707.title: Strong enhancements to superconducting properties of 1D systems from metallic reservoirs
arxiv-2507-18707.creator: J. E. Ebot, Sam Mardazad, Lorenzo Pizzino, Johannes S. Hofmann, Thierry Giamarchi, Adrian Kantian
arxiv-2507-18707.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. E. Ebot, Sam Mardazad, Lorenzo Pizzino, Johannes S. Hofmann, Thierry Giamarchi, Adrian Kantian. Using a 1D bilayer system comprised of pairing and metallic layers, the present work proves the striking power of reservoir-mediated boosting of superconductivity. Employing many-body numerics on large systems at zero and finite temperature, we unravel the complex processes by which the tuning of the metal parameters can impact the effective pairing strength as well as the long-range pair-pair-coupling mediated by the metal.

arxiv-2509-06148.title: Quasi-dust ekpyrotic scenario in Loop Quantum Cosmology
arxiv-2509-06148.creator: Emmanuel Frion, Mateo Pascual, Francesca Vidotto
arxiv-2509-06148.description: Abstract In the framework of Loop Quantum Cosmology, we study a cosmological bouncing model with two fields that reproduce the desired features of the primordial power spectra. The model combines the matter-bounce mechanism, that generates scale-invariant perturbations, with ekpyrotic contraction, that suppresses anisotropies leading to the bounce.

arxiv-2602-20391.title: Transient Plastic Spin Labeling with Chlorine Dioxide
arxiv-2602-20391.creator: Bence G. Márkus †, Sándor Kollarics, Kristóf Kály-Kullai, Bernadett Juhász, Dávid Beke, László Forró, Zoltán Noszticzius, Ferenc Simon
arxiv-2602-20391.description: Abstract ABSTRACT: Plastic waste, being one of the most important problems for humankind, poses severe threats to ecosystems, wildlife, and human health. Tracing, quantifying, and identifying types of plastic waste is of crucial importance to understand its environmental pathways and develop targeted strategies for reduction, recycling, and remediation.

pmc-11489830.title: Case Report: Post-operative mitral valve replacement complicating with a large cardiac mass and the role of TEE in Imaging
pmc-11489830.creator: Narasimha Pai D, Chaithra Nayak, Padmanabh Kamath, Syed Waleem Pasha, Deepa Noronha, Raif Kılıç, Adem Aktan, Raif Kılıç, chaithra Nayak, Adem Aktan, chaithra Nayak
pmc-11489830.description: BackgroundPostoperative complications are an integral part of valve surgery. Common complications include hematomas, bleeding, valve dehiscence, paravalvular leak, and acute PV thrombosis. With the available data from published articles, the rate of all valve-related complications is 0.7 to 3.5% per patient annually. [1] The pathology involved is multifactorial, often blood vessel injury leading to bleeding and hematoma.

pmc-11644466.title: Comparing Results from 2-D and 3-D Phenotyping Systems for Soybean Root System Architecture: A ‘Comparison of Apples and Oranges’?
pmc-11644466.creator: François Belzile, Waldiodio Seck, Prabhjot Sanghera, Liwen Han, Pierre Dutilleul, Konstantinos E Vlachonasios
pmc-11644466.description: Typically, root system architecture (RSA) is not visible, and realistically, high-throughput methods for RSA trait phenotyping should capture key features of developing root systems in solid substrates in 3D. In a published 2-D study using thin rhizoboxes, vermiculite as a growing medium, and photography for imaging, triplicates of 137 soybean cultivars were phenotyped for their RSA.

pmc-12510726.title: Genomic Evolution and Patterns of Horizontal Gene Transfer in Coccomorpha Species
pmc-12510726.creator: Yi‐Xin Huang, Ji‐Mu Lv, Cheng‐Yang Ding, Xin‐Yi Zheng, Xing‐Jie Liu, Xiao‐Nan Chen, Shun‐Hai Yu, Yin‐Feng Meng, Hao‐Yuan Hu, Xu Wang
pmc-12510726.description: As a significant group of agricultural and forestry pests, Coccomorpha warrants in‐depth investigation into their environmental adaptation mechanisms. This study conducted a comparative genomic analysis using five published chromosome‐level genomes of Coccomorpha species. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that the divergence times of these five species ranged from 333.18 to 84.

pmc-12550960.title: What Is ‘Muscle Health’? A Narrative Review and Conceptual Framework
pmc-12550960.creator: Katie L Boncella, Dustin J Oranchuk, Daniela Gonzalez-Rivera, Eric E Sawyer, Dawn M Magnusson, Michael O Harris-Love, José Peña-Amaro, Philippe Gorce
pmc-12550960.description: Background: Muscle health is an emerging concept linked to physical performance and functional independence. However, the term lacks a standardized definition and is often used as a broad muscle-related outcome descriptor. Clinical communication and research would benefit from a conceptual model of muscle health grounded in an established framework.

pmc-13056209.title: Computational and immunoinformatics approaches for designing phytocompound-based drugs and a multi-epitope vaccine targeting FemA, a cell wall protein of Staphylococcus aureus
pmc-13056209.creator: Md. Nazmussakib Shuvo, Tawsif Al Arian, Farhan Fuad, Mahmood Hasan Noman, Nuhu Alam, Mahbubul Kabir Himel, Aparna Shil
pmc-13056209.description: Staphylococcus aureus, a bacterial pathogen, is increasingly linked to severe healthcare-associated diseases, from mild skin infections to toxic shock syndrome. Due to limitations in conventional methods, we use computational techniques to screen potential phytocompounds for new drug development and to construct a multiepitope vaccine.
